defs.def: being the only one of its kind 唯一的；独一无二的

ex.s: While many visitors have never been to a farm at all, _____52_____ a sunflower farm, the unique setting allows them to _____53_____ the city for a while, breathe in the fresh air, gain a newfound _____54_____ for agriculture, and maybe even _____55_____ with their farming roots and what they may have taken for granted for too long.
ex.t: 虽然许多游客从未去过农场，更别说向日葵农场了，但这种独特的环境让他们能____53____

ex.s: Each ARTS FIRST festival is a unique annual celebration of the Harvard community's artistic creativity.
ex.t: 每个ARTS FIRST节是哈佛社区艺术创作的独特年度庆典.

ex.s: Lancom claims that it is unique in its ___________.（    ）
ex.t: Lancom声称,它在其        中是独一无二的。 ()

ex.s: As for the USA, it is almost unique among developed nations in having a population that is expected to grow by 20% from 2010—2030.
ex.t: 就美国而言,在发达国家中,人口预计将在2010-2030年期间增长20%,这几乎是独一无二的。

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 你还要对一种语言的独特疯狂感到疑惑,一种房子在燃烧时会燃烧,其中你填写表格,填充表格,警报响起后才会听到!

ex.s: We could also say You will also feel confused about the unique craziness of English.
ex.t: 我们还可以说,你也会对英语的独特疯狂感到困惑。

defs.def: very special or unusual 独特的；罕见的

ex.s: Smart recommendation engines analyze data such as exhibit popularity and visitors’ past behavior to suggest specific exhibits and events, making each visit unique and surprising. _____37_____ These digital assistants engage visitors in dynamic conversations and offer context-sensitive insights that deepen understanding and satisfy curiosity.
ex.t: 聪明的推荐引擎分析诸如展示受欢迎度和参观者过去的行为等数据,提出具体的展品和活动,使每次参观都变得独特和令人惊讶。

ex.s: Families who volunteer together have the unique experience of working toward a common goal. ___40___ Everyone brings something unique to the table and can connect with each other in a new way.
ex.t: 志愿工作的家庭在努力实现共同目标方面有着独特的经验。

ex.s: Each type of literature has its unique end.
ex.t: 每一种文学都有其独特的结局.

ex.s: This area, with ____46____ (it) unique and breathtaking natural beauty, must be well preserved ____47____ all people of the nation to enjoy — as a national park.
ex.t: 这个地区,有————————————————独特,令人叹息的自然美景,必须很好地保存——————————47————全国各族人民享受——作为国家公园.

ex.s: Because of its unique composition.
ex.t: 这个地区以其独特而令人惊叹的自然美景，必须被妥善保护，供全国各族人民____47____作为国家公园来欣赏。

ex.s: The result is a diverse line of projects that each advance along their unique paths.
ex.t: 结果是,每个项目都沿着各自独特的道路发展。

ex.s: Komodo National Park, officially recognized in 1980, is popular for ecotourism because of its unique biodiversity.
ex.t: 科莫多国家公园于1980年被正式承认,因其独特的生物多样性而为生态旅游所欢迎.

ex.s: From broadcasting to street art, these are just 4 of the 17 highly unique camps being offered.
ex.t: 从广播到街头艺术,这些只是17个非常独特的营地中的4个。

ex.s: Researchers from Brigham Young University discovered that fathers are in a unique position to help their adolescent children learn persistence.
ex.t: 来自Brigham Young大学的研究人员发现,父亲们在帮助青少年子女学习持久性方面处于独特的地位.

ex.s: “There are relatively few studies that stress the unique role of fathers,” Padilla-Walker said.
ex.t: Padilla-Walker说,“强调父亲独特作用的研究相对较少。”

ex.s: A．her unique way to locate herself
ex.t: A. 她独特的定位方式

ex.s: Moore wants to use her unique talent to help others find their smiles.
ex.t: Moore希望利用她独特的天赋来帮助其他人找到他们的微笑。

ex.s: Explore the monuments and memorials on the National Mall as your guide shares unique facts and history at each stop.
ex.t: 探索国家商场上的纪念碑和纪念馆 作为你的向导 每站分享独特的事实和历史.

ex.s: Frequent stops are made for photo taking as your guide offers unique facts and history.
ex.t: 在国家广场（National Mall）探索纪念碑与纪念馆，导游会在每一站分享独特的事实与历史。

ex.s: Its unique style.
ex.t: 其独特的风格.

ex.s: Using shells for money was common throughout the Pacific islands as late as the early 1900s, but Malaita is unique in that they are still used today.
ex.t: 早在1900年代初,整个太平洋岛国就普遍使用贝壳来换取金钱,但Malaita之所以独特,是因为贝壳今天仍在使用。

ex.s: TOKNOW Magazine is a big hit in the world of children’s publishing, bringing a unique combination of challenging ideas and good fun to young fans every month.
ex.t: TOKNOW杂志在儿童出版界大受欢迎，为年轻读者带来挑战性思维与乐趣的独特结合。

ex.s: Its unique feature, from which it gets its name, is the bright red skin on the top of its head.
ex.t: 其独特的特征,从中得名,是其头顶的明亮的红色皮肤.

ex.s: The voices themselves sounded really unique-some of the female voices were so high that I was sure they could break glass!
ex.t: 声音本身听起来非常独特 一些女性的声音是如此之高 我敢肯定,他们可以打破玻璃!

ex.s: Because I thought ballet was more or less the same everywhere, I was totally unprepared for its unique beauty.
ex.t: 因为我觉得芭蕾舞在任何地方都差不多一样, 所以我完全没有准备好它独特的美丽。

ex.s: I really want to go to a place for the summer vacation, ________ especially with beautiful scenery and unique culture.
ex.t: 我很想去度假的地方 尤其是有美丽的风景和独特的文化

defs.def: belonging to or connected with one particular person, place or thing （某人、地或事物）独具的，特有的

ex.s: The ability to judge others’ intentions is an indicator of possessing “theory of mind” which was once thought to be unique to humans.
ex.t: 判断他人意图的能力是拥有 " 思想理论 " 的一个指标,这种理论曾经被认为是人类特有的。

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 也许当你想到讲故事时 第一件事就是幻想之地 在你的脑海中成型 而爸爸妈妈告诉你关于王子的故事 城堡和怪物的故事

ex.s: These patterns are unique to each person.
ex.t: 这些模式是每个人特有的.

ex.s: If you’re looking for a unique adventure, the Space and Aviation Center (SAC) is the place to be.
ex.t: 如果你在寻找一场独特的冒险，太空与航空中心（SAC）就是该去的地方。
